title: The Cheras
definition: The Cheras (or Keralaputras) were a major South Indian dynasty that ruled over parts of modern-day Kerala and Tamil Nadu, evolving from an early Sangam-era power into the influential Mahodayapuram Cheras (Kulasekharas) during the 9th–12th centuries.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the political, cultural, and maritime history of South India; frequently tested in the context of the 'Tripartite Struggle' era and the evolution of the Malayalam language.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Cheras.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
